policy.scope: P47 and Spitfire matched-condition climb; clean speed/turn model unchanged
policy.selection: Lowest aircraft-balanced training mean squared climb residual / (250 ft/min)^2; nonnegative configuration loss is fitted on fit rows only. No held-out row chooses parameters.
policy.foldAcceptance: Refit BOTH the linear-MAP/constant-CD0 control and candidate on identical split fit rows; candidate own-split check MAE must not worsen for either aircraft. Also preserve the stricter comparison against retained coefficients, which can have trained on alternate check rows.

hypotheses.charge: MAP-ratio exponent 2/3 to 1 brackets a simplified polytropic charge-density response. Installed charge temperature, friction and intercooler effects are unmeasured; this is an engineering proxy, not an identified engine law.
hypotheses.configuration: Nonnegative blend of constant CD0 and loss power proportional to source-conditioned shaft power. Normalize at first recorded climb input, never use its observed climb rate in the shape. No altitude polynomial or aircraft-specific climb multiplier.

policy.scenarioQualification: Assumed level-power +/-3% and mass +/-2% stress, applied equally to old/new models; not historical uncertainty bounds.
policy.initialFoldComparison: Refit each alternative split independently; each target aircraft own-split check MAE must not worsen relative to the retained model. All observations already exposed; no blind historical validation.
policy.developmentNote: After the initial probe, the fold comparison was corrected to refit the linear control on the same data as the candidate. The initial retained-coefficient comparison remains reported and is not silently called a pass. All data already exposed; no blind-validation claim.
